sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000109-P1, was presented by MERCK & COMPANY (the Supplier) to Summit Wellness Center 109 on May 10, 2025.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: a Tier 2 rebate of 4%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a commitment of 870 MMR doses per year.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: countered by the Customer.
